name: Yazu Haruki
source:
A soccer-loving boy who is a classmate and close friend of Kota.
He prefers hanging out with the guys—like Kota—over interacting with the opposite sex,
and generally finds girls annoying.
Unlike the quiet Kota, he has a rambunctious personality; however, he harbors a complex about his unusually large penis, revealing a shy side that prevents him from even bathing with friends.

He typically wears his school uniform with shorts. He has a mischievous vibe, often sporting a Band-Aid on his knee.
He has a large, uncircumcised penis with phimosis.
